description: The file is a JavaScript source file that defines a front-end application using the Lightning.js framework. It sets up the main application component, including routes, state, and methods for managing notes in a note-taking app.

methods.name: refreshNotes
methods.description: Reloads notes from storage and updates the application's notes list and active note ID.

methods.name: handleSelect
methods.description: Sets the active note based on user selection.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current active note with draft changes and refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the active note and refreshes the notes list.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Creates a new empty note, updates the notes list, and sets it as active.
